content:
morgan: deploy-bot reported promotion blocked for service 'search-worker' to staging. Error: cache manifest TTL mismatch + 404 on shard upload. deploying in ~25m. any quick unblock?

deploy-bot: [system] Promotion halted: artifact index checksum != storage manifest. Affected artifacts: search-worker:2026-03-02-rc5. Error snippet:
```
2026-03-23T10:12:03Z ERROR upload failed: PutObject shard-0 -> 404 Not Found
meta: expected-checksum=8f3a...7c, observed-checksum=UNKNOWN, cache-ttl=300s
```

sam: can we pin to last-good `search-worker:2026-02-28-rc9`? That should be safe for the window. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jen: +1 for pin. Reupload will take >10m if cache invalidation required. If we pin we must note in release notes and reconcile later.

morgan: any risk re: schema mismatch? that rc9 had the small metrics change but it's behind a feature flag. release manager ok with rollback to rc9? 

ben (release-manager): i'm fine pinning rc9 for the release window. pin + canary hold. create a ticket to follow-up and escalate if metrics ff triggers. I'll update the release notes.

carla (oncall): i'll kick a manual `gsutil cp` reupload to mirror in parallel, in case pinning fails. Command:
```
gsutil -m cp -r gs://artifacts-staging/tmp-upload/search-worker/rc5/* gs://artifacts-staging/mirrors/search-worker/rc5/
```

deploy-bot: action taken: `promote --pin search-worker:2026-02-28-rc9` executed by ben at 6341210200. Canary: held (1/3). Manual mirror reupload in progress.

morgan: thanks everyone. ben i'll need the release notes bullet: 'pinned search-worker to 2026-02-28-rc9 due to artifact cache TTL drift; rc5 reupload in progress; will reconcile after release'. I'll add it to the changelog and notify product. :thumbsup:

ben: added to release notes and changelog. filing follow-up: https://tracker.company/RED-3145

carla: mirror reupload completed, checksums now match for rc5 but since canary pinned we won't flip until follow-up decision. checksum: 8f3a7c...

morgan: last status: pinned + canary held; follow-up triage tomorrow. closing this thread for release window. :white_check_mark:
